title: English Practice Quiz 0883
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.
